title: Contributing
text: Please open issue substantial change. Include minimal synthetic example, expected actual behaviour, package version software environment. Never attach confidential personally identifying data. Documentation corrections identify page section. Keep examples small, deterministic practical within documented scientific scope. Separate presentation changes numerical, model default changes. Methodological changes require explicit review; passing smoke test evidence statistical guarantee production-study result. Use existing tests public interfaces. Explain new dependency preserve citation, data-source attribution licensing. Report validation limits rather making unmeasured performance claims.

Consequently, total run count R_n one first block plus one every change adjacent observations: R_n=1+\sum_{=2}^{n}\mathbf{1}(X_i\ne X_{-1}). \mathbf{1}(\cdot) equals one statement true zero otherwise. expression defines package’s random variable valid non-empty binary sequences.

title: BernoulliRuns
text: Documentation · Get started · Reference Conceptual sequence illustration; colours identify runs, fitted probabilities.  BernoulliRuns computes exact distribution total number runs non-empty sequence mutually independent Bernoulli trials. Success probabilities may vary position supplied user. first public API contains four functions: count_runs() counts maximal equal-value blocks observed binary sequence. runs_distribution() returns exact probability mass cumulative probabilities. runs_mean() returns exact expected run count. runs_tail() returns inclusive lower upper one-sided tail probability.

title: BernoulliRuns

title: BernoulliRuns
text: package treats supplied probabilities fixed assumes mutual independence. estimate probabilities, model dependent Markov sequences, calculate longest-run distributions, define two-sided p-value. probabilities estimated observations, reported tail probability automatically calibrated exact test. finite-state formulation follows Fu Koutras (1994), https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1994.10476841.
